pieces.alt: Two white rabbits leaping toward each other inside a red heart, music notes swirling around them.
A smiling lavender-striped Cheshire cat on a starry navy stamp, its tail curling up out of the frame.
The word HACK in rounded letters filled with swirling pastel colours, in an orange frame.
A pink pennant with HACK lettered down it in gold, edged with gold scrollwork.
The word HACK spelled across four playing cards in red, green, lilac and blue, on a scalloped navy ground.
The word HACK in solid black letters: an H with rabbit ears, an A shaped like a chess pawn, a C like a clock face and a K marked with a spade.
Two mice typing on laptops labelled HACK and MIT, a tangled scribble above their heads.
A ring of keys tied with a pink bow: a heart-shaped padlock, an ornate gold key and a small green charm.
A startled yellow mouse with a pink heart on its cheek, in an ornate gold frame.
Two butterflies, one yellow and one pale pink, in a patch of blue sky with small clouds.
A green frog on a lily pad in a pond, its long pink tongue stretched out toward a small winged insect.
The letters BP shaped from green hedge, dotted with pink and yellow flowers.
A dogwood in full pink bloom, its wide flat crown over a short brown trunk.
A catalpa with a tall rounded crown of green and pale yellow leaves.
A clethra shrub thick with spikes of white flowers among green leaves.
A ginkgo with a dense, rounded green crown on a slender trunk.
A waterfall maple, a low wide mound of fine green leaves.
A waterfall maple in autumn, its weeping leaves turned orange and pink.
A weeping willow with pale yellow branches trailing to the ground.
A weeping willow drawn in blues, its long branches pouring down.
A green weeping willow, its long branches hanging nearly to the ground.
A soft painted portrait of Childe, ginger hair falling over blue eyes, a hand pushing it back and a red earring at his jaw.
A portrait of Claude, dark tousled hair with a small braid, green eyes and a gold earring, in a yellow-lined collar.
A Google doodle of a family sharing a meal, the letters of Google worked into a rocking chair, a dog and the people around the table.
Durin with pink hair and dark horns, huge black and crimson dragon wings spread behind him.
A portrait of Flins, long blue-violet hair over one eye, in a high-collared dark coat.
Gojo in round dark glasses with spiky white hair, beside Howl with long black hair and a green earring.
A wide-eyed girl with long dark hair caught eating at an open fridge in the dark.
L in a white long-sleeved shirt, thumb at his lip, against a red ground with a gothic L.
A loose sketch of a face with pale blue hair and long lashes, in washes of blue and peach.
Rafayel with pale hair looking back over his shoulder on a beach in lilac evening light.
A dark-haired vampire with red eyes biting the neck of a screaming man, blood running from the bite.
Xianyun with long dark green hair and teal eyes, framed by white flowers, a gold knot tied at her collar.
Caleb in profile, dark hair over his eyes and a black suit, a hand raised to his mouth against a deep red ground.
Kazuha with pale hair streaked red and red eyes, holding a glowing violet butterfly against a dark night.
Kirara with long golden hair and green eyes, a hand raised to her hat, pink blossoms behind her.
A logo for SSP Genomics, NMSU 2024: the letters SSP over desert mountains and a starry sky, with a microscope and DNA in the word genomics.
A bust of a man with sandy hair, glasses and a beard, in a brown jacket, green argyle sweater vest and tie.
